spans.s:
1. अज, अस्, m. a drove; a driver, mover, instigator,
leader; epithet given in the Vedas to Indra. Rudra,
one of the Maruts, Agni, and the sun; in later works
to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Kāma (see also 2 अ-ज);
the leader of a flock; a he-goat or ram [cf. Gr. αἴξ
[]
αἰγος Lith. ožys]; the sign Aries; the vehicle of
the sun; N. of a descendant of Viśvāmitra, and of
Daśaratha's or Dīrghabāhu's father; N. of a mineral
substance; of a kind of rice; of the moon; (अस्), m.
pl., N. of a class of Ṛṣis; of a people mentioned in
the Vedas; (आ), f., N. of Prakṛti or Nature, of Māyā
or Illusion; a she-goat; N. of a plant whose bulbs
resemble the udder of a goat.
—अज-कर्ण, अस्, m.
a goat's ear; a plant or tree, Terminalia Alata
Tomentosa.
—अज-कर्णक, अस्, m. the Śāl-tree,
Shorea Robusta.
—अज-कूला, f., N. of a town of the
Bodhis.
—अज-क्षीर, अम्, n., Ved. goat's milk.
—अज-गन्ध, अस्, m. smell of a he-goat; (अस्, आ,
अम्), smelling like a goat.
—अज-गन्धा or अज-
गन्धिका, f. shrubby basil, Ocymum Gratissimum.
—अज-गन्धिनी, f. a plant, also called अजशृङ्गी,
q. v.
—अज-गर, अस्, m. (that swallows a goat), a
huge serpent, probably boa constrictor; (ई), f., N. of a
plant.
—अज-गल्लिका, f. ‘goat's cheek,’ an infantile
disease.
—अज-जीव or अज-जीविक, अस्, m. ‘who lives
by goats,’ a goat-herd.
—अज-ता, f. a multitude of
goats; the being a goat.
—अज-त्व or अजा-त्व, अम्,
n. the being a goat.
—अज-दण्डी, f. a plant, also
called ब्रह्मदण्डी.
—अज-देवता, आस्, f. pl. the
25th lunar mansion.
—अज-नामक, अस्, m. (named
Aja or Viṣṇu), a mineral substance.
—अज-प, अस्,
m. a goat-herd.
—अज-पथ, अस्, m. ‘goat's road,’
probably synonymous with अज-वीथी, q. v.
—अज-
पद or अज-पाद, अस्, आ, अम्, goat-footed.
—अज-
पाद्, त्, m., Ved. epithet of the divinity called अज.
—अज-पार्श्व, अस्, m. (having black sides like a
goat), epithet of Śvetakarṇa's son Rājīvalocana.
—अज-पाल, अस्, m. a goat-herd; N. of Daśaratha's
father.
—अज-भक्ष, अस्, m. ‘goat's food,’ N. of a
plant, Varvūra.
—अज-मायु, उस्, m., Ved. bleating
like a goat.
—अज-मार, अस्, m., N. of a tribe or a
prince.
—अज-मीढ or अज-मीऌह, अस्, m., N. of a
son of Suhotra, the author of some Vedic hymns; of
a grandson of Suhotra; surname of Yudhisṭhira.
—अज-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, goat-faced; (ई), f., N. of
a Rākṣasī.
—अज-मेरु, N. of a place, Ajmir (?).
—अज-मोद, अस्, m. or अज-मोदा or अज-मोदिका,
f. ‘goat's delight,’ N. of various plants, common
Carroway, the species called Ajwaen (Ligusticum
Ajwaen), and especially a species of Parsley, Apium
Involucratum.
—अजर्षभ (˚ज-ऋष्˚), अस्, m. the
best goat.
—अज-लम्बन, अम्, n. antimony.
—अज-
लोमन्, आ, m. or अज-लोमी, f., N. of a plant, Cowage,
Carpopogon Pruriens; (अ), n. goat's hair.
—अज-वस्ति,
इस्, m., N. of a tribe; (अयस्), m. pl. the members of
that tribe.
—अज-वाह, अस्, m., N. of a district.
—अज-वीथी, f. ‘goat's road,’ N. of one of the three
divisions of the southern path, or one of the three
paths in which the sun, moon, and planets move,
comprehending the asterisms मूला, पूर्वाषाढ,
and उत्तराषाढ.
—अज-शृङ्गी, f. ‘goat's horn,’
N. of a shrub, Odina Wodier, used as a charm and as
a remedy for sore eyes, — the fruit resembles a goat's
horn.
—अज-स्तुन्द, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—अज-हा,
f. Cowage, Carpopogon Pruriens.
—अजा-कृपाणीय,
अस्, आ, अम्, like the goat and shears in the fable.
—अजा-क्षीर, अम्, n. goat's milk.
—अजा-गल, अस्,
m. goat's neck.
—अजागल-स्तन, अस्, m. nipple or
fleshy protuberance on the neck of some Indian goats,
and an emblem of any useless or worthless object or
person.
—अजा-जीव, अस्, m. (who lives by goats), a
goat-herd.
—अजा-तौल्वलि, इस्, m., N. of a Muni who
lived on the milk of goats; (given by grammarians as
an example of compounds in which the middle term
is left out).
—अजाद (अज-अद), अस्, m. ‘goat-eater,’
the ancestor of a warrior tribe.
—अजादनी (˚ज-अद्˚),
f. a species of prickly night-shade.
—अजान्त्री (˚ज-
अन्˚), f. a pot-herb, Convolvulus Argenteus.
—अजा-
पयस्, अस्, n. goat's milk.
—अजा-पालक, अस्, आ, अम्,
tending goats; (अस्), m. a goat-herd.
—अजाविक (अज-
अव्˚), अम्, n. goats and sheep, small cattle.
—अजाश्व
(अज-अश्), अम्, n. goats and horses; (अस्), m. Pūṣan
or the Sun who has goats for horses.
—अजैकपाद्
(अज-एक्˚), त्, m. epithet of Viṣṇu; of one of the
eleven Rudras.
—अजैडक (अज-एड्˚), अम्, n. goats
and rams.

अज 2. अ-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, not born, existing
from all eternity; (अस्), m. Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva,
Kāma; (आ), f. Prakṛti or Nature, Māyā or Illusion
(see also 1. अज, s. v. अज् and 1. अजन).
1. अज; for ‘(अस्), m. pl.’ read (आस्), m. pl.

अजा अजा, f. a goat; Prakṛti; Māyā. See s.v.
1. अज, where the compounds of अजा will also be found.

अजक, अस्, m., N. of a descendant of Purūravas;
also of a king of Magadha; अजका or अजिका, f. a
young she-goat; a disease of the pupil of the eye,
small reddish tumours (compared to kids), protruding
through the transparent cornea and discharging pus.
—अजका-जात, अम्, n. the same disease of the eyes.
आजक, अम्, n. a flock of goats.
अजन, अजनि, अजि, अज्म, &c., see s. v.

अजन 1. अजन, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अज्.), Brahmā
‘the agitator;’ (अम्), n. act of instigating or mov-
ing.
—अजन-योनि-ज, अस्, m. (born fr. अजन, i. e.
Brahmā); N. of Dakṣa.

अजन 2. अ-जन, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जन्), desti-
tute of living beings, especially of men; desert; (अस्),
m. an insignificant person.
आ-जान, अम्, n. birth, descent, species; birth-place.
आजान आ-जान, आजानेय. See under आजन्.

अजकव अजकव, अस्, m. (etymology un-
known), Śiva's bow.
—अजकाव, अस्, अम्, m. n. Śiva's
bow; (अस्), m. a venomous kind of vermin, cen-
tipede or scorpion; (अम्), n. sacrificial vessel dedicated
to Mitra and Varuṇa.
—अजगव or अजगाव, अम्,
n. Śiva's bow; the southern portion of the path of
the sun, moon, and planets; N. of a snake priest.

अजघन्य अ-जघन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not last;
not least.

अजघ्निवस् अ-जघ्निवस्, आन्, उषी, अत् (perf.
part. fr. rt. हन्), not having killed.

अजटा अ-जटा, f. a plant, Flacourtia Cata-
phracta; also अजडा and अज्झटा.

अजड अ-जड, अस्, आ, अम्, not torpid or
stupid; (आ), f., N. of two plants; see अजटा and
कपिकच्छु, Carpopogon Pruriens.
—अजड-धी, ईस्,
ईस्, इ, of a vigorous mind, energetic, bold.

अजथ्या अजथ्या, f. yellow jasmin (fit for
goats ?).
अजनि, इस्, f. a path, road; see also अजि.

अजानि अ-जानि, इस्, or अ-जानिक, अस्, m.
having no wife.
आजनि, इस्, f., Ved. a stick for driving.

आ-जानि, इस्, f., Ved. birth, descent; noble birth;
(Sāy.) a mother.

अ-जननि, इस्, f. privation of birth, cessation of exist-
ence; अजननिर् अस्तु तस्य, ‘may he cease to exist !’

अ-जन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, improper to be produced or
born; unfit or unfavourable for mankind; (अम्), n.
any portent or natural phenomenon unfavourable to
mankind, as an earthquake.

अजप 1. अ-जप, अस्, m. (rt. जप्), one who
does not repeat prayers; a reader of heterodox works;
(आ), f. the mantra or formula called haṃsa, which con-
sists only of a number of inhalations and exhalations.

अजप 2. अज-प, अस्, m. a goat-herd. See
s. v. 1. अज.
अजमीढ अज-मीढ, अस्, m. See s. v. 1. अज.

आजमीढ आजमीढ, अस्, m., N. of a king in
the Mahā-bhārata.
अजम्भ अ-जम्भ, अस्, m. (toothless), a frog.

अजय अ-जय, अस्, m. non-victory, defeat;
(अस्, आ, अम्), unconquered, unsurpassed, invincible; (अस्),
m., N. of Viṣṇu; of a lexicographer; of a river; (आ),
f. hemp; N. of a friend of Durgā; Māyā or Illusion.

अ-जय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, invincible, improper to be
won at play.

अजर अ-जर, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जॄ), not subject
to old age, undecaying, ever young; (आ), f., N. of two
plants, Aloe Perfoliata and Jīrṇapañjhī.
—अजरामर-
वत् (˚र-अम्˚), ind. as if undecaying and immortal.

अ-जरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not suffering from old age,
not decaying.

अ-जरयु, उस्, उस्, उ, not subject to old age or
decay.

अ-जरस्, another form for अजर, used only in
some cases.

अ-जर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not friable, not digestible;
not subject to old age or decay; (अम्), n. friendship.

अजवस् अ-जवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. not quick,
inactive.

अजस्र अ-जस्र, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जस्, ‘to injure’
not to be killed or interrupted), perpetual.
—अजस्रम्
or अजस्रेण, ind. perpetually, for ever, ever.

अजहत् अ-जहत् (pres. part. fr. rt. हा with
अ), not dropping or losing (used in compounds).
—अजहत्-स्वार्था, f., N. of a rhetorical figure, an
elliptical use of words in which their original meaning
is not dropped, as “white ones” for “white horses,”
“lances” for “men with lances.”
—अजहल्-लिङ्ग,
अस्, m. (in grammar) said of a noun not dropping its
original gender, when used like an adjective.

अजागर अ-जागर, अस्, आ, अम्, not awake, not
wakeful; (अस्), a plant, Eclipta or Verbesina Prostrata.

आजगर आजगर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अज-गर),
treating of the boa or large serpent; (a chapter in
the Mahā-bhārata.)

अजाजि अजा-जि, इस्, or अजा-जी, f. (अजा with rt.
जि?, that overcomes goats); Cumin seed, Cuminum
Cyminum; Ficus Oppositifolia; Nigella Indica.

अजात अ-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, unborn, not yet
born, not yet developed.
—अजात-ककुद्, त्, m. a young
bull whose hump (ककुद्) is yet undeveloped.
—अजात-
पक्ष, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having undeveloped wings.
—अजात-व्यञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, having an unde-
veloped beard.
—अजात-व्यवहार, अस्, m. having
his majority unattained, a minor, a youth under fif-
teen.
—अजात-शत्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, having no enemy;
having no adversary of equal standing; (उस्), m., N. of
Śiva, of Yudhiṣṭhira, of a king of Kāśī, of a son of
Śamīka, of a son of Vidmisāra or Bimbisāra, and con-
temporary of Śākyamuni.
—अजातानुशय (˚त-अनु˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, having no regret.
—अजातारि (˚त-अरि), इस्,
m. (having no enemy), Yudhiṣṭhira.

अजानत् अ-जानत्, अन्, अती, अत् (pres. part. of
rt. ज्ञा with अ), not knowing, unaware.

आजानेय, अस्, ई, अम्, of noble origin, of good breed
(as a horse), fearless, undaunted; (अस्), m. a well-
bred horse.

आजानेय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. of good breed, well-
bred.

अजामि अ-जामि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. not of kin,
not related; unfriendly; (in grammar) not corres-
ponding.
—अजामि-ता, f., Ved. absence of connection,
friendliness, or similarity.

अजायमान अ-जायमान, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. जन्),
not being born, not subject to birth.
आजकार आजकार, अस्, m. Śiva's bull.

आजगव आजगव, अस्, m. the bow of Śiva
[cf. अजकाव].

आजन् आ-जन्, cl. 4. A., Ved. -जायते, -जनि-
तुम्, to be born or come into existence, to be pro-
duced or born from; to beget, cause to be born,
render prolific.
आ-जनन, अम्, n. birth, origin.

आ-जन्म, ind. from birth, since birth.
—आजन्म-
सुरभि-पत्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a plant (the leaves of
which are fragrant from their first appearance).
आ-जाति, इस्, f. birth, origin.

आजप् आ-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -पितुम्, to
mutter or whisper to.

आजरसम् आ-जरसम् or आ-जरसाय, ind.,
Ved. till old age.

आजवन आ-जवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जु with आ),
rushing at, attacking, fighting.

आजवस्तेय आजवस्तेय (patronymic fr. अज-
वस्ति Pāṇini

आजवाह आजवाह or आजवाहक fr. अज-वाह
Pāṇini

आजातशत्रव आजातशत्रव, अस्, m. (fr. अजा-
त-शत्रु), epithet of Bhadrasena in the Śatapatha-
Brāhmaṇa

आजाद्य आजाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, originating from
the warrior-tribe called Ajādas or a chief of that tribe.
आ-जयन, अम्, n. conquering.
अज्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, ending in a vowel.
